questions.solution:
Pattern → sum of previous two no. + 2
[2+5] + 2 = 9
[5+9] + 2 = 16
[9 + 16] + 2=27
[16 + 27] + 2 = 45
[27 + 45] + 2 = 74

पैटर्न → पिछली दो संख्याओं का योग + 2
[2+5] + 2 = 9
[5+9] + 2 = 16
[9 + 16] + 2=27
[16 + 27] + 2 = 45
[27 + 45] + 2 = 74
